FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 15
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Mark Shirey
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/17/2026
House Bill 15 as introduced would decrease sales tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund,
beginning in fiscal year 2027, by an estimated range of $14.7 million to $18.7 million annually,
by exempting the gross proceeds of the sale of optical aids from state sales and use tax.
This bill could also decrease sales and use tax receipts to local governments by a cumulative
estimated range of $19.3 million to $24.5 million annually, if all local governments adopted the
exemption provided by this bill.
